notes.title: Gloomy Eyes will release September 12th on PC/Mac and consoles!
notes.notes:
Wanderer, I wish you a good day.
But what does “day” mean, anyway?
Where I dwell, no light breaks the night,
For the Sun has vanished from sight.

Yet deep within the shadow’s seam,
A distant spark begins to gleam.
A boy, eyes shining through the dark,
A girl, chasing each glowing spark.

They must recall, through ash and ember,
Their quest begins: the 12th of September.
On Xbox, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PC and Mac,
They’ll brave the dark to bring the Sun back.
